title: Biome Title
description: This mod displays the biomes you pass by
body:
# Biome Title

A simple but useful mod

## Config

### How To Use: Color Type / "from config"

.minecraft/config/biome_title.json5
```json
{
  "colorMap": {
    "<Biome ID>":"<Color (like #114514 / 0x114514 / 123456)>"...
  }
}
```
### Other

tips translation key: "tips.biometitle.<namespace>.<id>"
